Orangeburg County is South Carolina's largest county by land area, a rural I-26/I-95 crossroads anchored by the city of Orangeburg and home to South Carolina State University and Claflin University. Its economy runs on row-crop agriculture and interstate-driven industrial recruitment, while Santee, on Lake Marion at the I-95 interchange, supports a separate tourism and second-home market.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: November 8, 2026
